description: This file implements the server entry point for a Remix-based web application, handling HTTP requests, distinguishing between bot and browser clients, setting response headers, and rendering React components to streams.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that sets CORS headers, manages OPTIONS requests, and delegates requests based on user-agent detection to bot or browser specific handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles rendering responses for bot clients using server-side streaming and React's renderToPipeableStream.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles rendering responses for browser clients with similar streaming logic as bot handler.
